hero.title: Save Thousands vs. 6%
hero.lead: A full-service listing for a flat fee, from a Friendswood broker who has sold hundreds of homes across the Houston area.
hero.imageAlt: A two-story brick and stone home with a landscaped front lawn

divisions.title: Sell Your Home
divisions.text: A full-service listing for a flat fee instead of a 6% commission, as low as $3,995 and paid at closing.

divisions.title: Buy a Home
divisions.text: Buyer clients receive a $1,500 moving allowance and a free one-year home warranty.

divisions.title: Free Home Valuation
divisions.text: A market analysis of what your home is worth before you decide anything.

divisions.title: Photography and 3D Tours
divisions.text: Free high-definition photography with a virtual tour, Matterport 3D walkthrough and drone shots as needed.

divisions.title: MLS and Portal Exposure
divisions.text: Your listing goes on the MLS with links to Realtor.com, Homes.com, Trulia, Zillow, Facebook and X.

divisions.title: Contract to Closing
divisions.text: We pre-qualify buyers, negotiate the contract, arrange the inspections and appraisal, and supervise the closing.

about.title: Led by broker Rob Roy
about.text: Rob Roy founded Texas Flat Fee Realtors after three decades in Houston real estate and hundreds of homes sold, and he holds multiple Top Producer awards from the Houston Association of Realtors. The office works as a traditional brokerage: pricing, marketing, showings, negotiation and paperwork are all handled here, and the flat fee is paid at closing after the home has sold.
about.imageAlt: Rob Roy, broker and owner of Texas Flat Fee Realtors, holding a set of house keys

reviews.author: Kiet Nguyen
reviews.text: Rob Roy sold our house very quickly. He was always available to answer our questions by email, phone or text.

reviews.author: Craig Alfred
reviews.text: I used Texas Flat Fee Realtors to sell my home in 3 days. Rob was very attentive to our needs and provided an excellent full service experience for us.

reviews.author: Brian Bodel
reviews.text: Texas Flat Fee Realtors saved us thousands with their flat-fee structure while providing excellent service.
